# Gesture FX

> Gesture-triggered camera effects in the browser. Frame a shot with your
> hands and the picture inside becomes a cartoon, with no server, no upload
> and no manual editing.

Licence: CC BY 4.0, attribution required
Repository created: 1 September 2026
